integrity: The five-circuit list is obtained by exact reconstruction from the printed 22-vertex polytope and exhaustive rational-rank checks of all row supports of sizes one, two and three. The bundled verifier reproduces the initiating source's rank and coloop checks before performing the new circuit enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the minimum-cardinality circuits of the finite 26-row node subsystem. It does not classify all circuits and does not assert smoothability of the mixed-singularity threefold, which also has four del Pezzo-cone points.
title: Five minimal three-node circuits in Wuebben's mirror node subsystem
